title: Balak’s anger; fourth prophecy
english: [[Fourth prophecy >> Bible:Numbers 24:10-19]]. Balak strikes his hands in anger: I called you to curse, and you have blessed; flee to your place.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC (Numbers).
